text: El Camino Health is a not-for-profit hospital system in Santa Clara County, California, running two acute-care hospitals in Los Gatos and Mountain View and a network of clinics.

source.name: El Camino Health - About Us
source.quote: El Camino Health is a nationally recognized and locally trusted healthcare system serving residents in the Bay Area. With two not-for-profit acute care hospitals in Los Gatos and Mountain View
